rationale: No blocking findings survive: this is a verbatim move, so the 16 defects that held up (e.g. provider reindex without a WRITE check, assistants listing without a READ check, confluence guardrail-only edits dropped, base64 vs base64url in _parse_jwt_exp, reindex paths passing the pre-move project name, untested admin/application access wiring, missing future-annotations and typing in the new modules) are pre-existing and recorded in /home/taras_spashchenko/EPAM/cm/codemie/docs/superpowers/tasks/2026-10-09-epmcdme-15651-step3-index-package/code-review-deferred.md, and 6 candidates were filtered as noise. The diff is oversized: every route module and its guards were read directly, but the deleted index.py could not be diffed and no repo search ran, so byte-identity and the importer/doc sweep rest on the acceptance lens, while route dump, fresh-interpreter import, make ruff and test runs remain Stage 7 evidence. Confidence is low because of the oversized diff; no lens failed or was truncated and standards coverage was complete.
